basics.name: Rosmar Alejandra Mendoza Canchica
basics.label: Semi Senior Backend Developer | Golang & Python | Distributed Systems
basics.summary: Computer Engineer and Backend Developer with 4+ years of experience designing and scaling high-traffic microservices and RESTful APIs in Golang, Python, and Java. Proven track record at hyper-scale companies like MercadoLibre and the Fintech sector, ensuring 99%+ availability SLAs, efficient concurrency, and relational database optimization (PostgreSQL). Specialized in distributed architectures, CI/CD, and AI-assisted development.

Completed MercadoLibre's Backend Golang Bootcamp, specializing in Go distributed architecture, concurrency, goroutines, and high-scale engineering practices.
Optimized SQL queries and data models in PostgreSQL, reducing latency on critical endpoints and improving overall system performance.
Integrated AI tools (Cursor and Claude) into daily workflows to speed up endpoint delivery, refactor legacy code, and boost unit test coverage.
Managed on-call rotation shifts and real-time monitoring with Datadog and New Relic, troubleshooting production incidents to preserve core platform stability.
